besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Hulle is ... vriendinne' / 'hulle stap').
besluite.rede: Both sides have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 requires the comma.

besluite.fout: 'lank gevat om' copies English 'took long to'.
besluite.rede: 'Sy was lank besig om' is the natural Afrikaans and says exactly the same.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Niemand het ... opgedaag nie' / 'Nandi het alleen gewag').
besluite.rede: Two independent clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'daardie selfde week' copies English 'that same week', and 'stil geword in die klas' puts the place phrase stiffly after the verb.
besluite.rede: 'in dieselfde week ook in die klas stil geword' is natural Afrikaans with the same time, place and meaning.
'die langste van almal gebly' already reads naturally, so the swap is a lateral move in the story.

besluite.fout: 'Sy het gevra dat Lerato niks vir niemand sê nie' is a stiff, formal construction for a child's request.
besluite.rede: 'Sy het Lerato gevra om vir niemand iets te sê nie' is the natural construction; same people, same request.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Lerato het niks belowe nie' / 'sy het ... gedink').
besluite.rede: Two independent clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses ('Nandi was nog net so stil' / 'sy het ... gebly').
besluite.rede: Two independent clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: The comma is required, and 'niks teruggehou nie' is the tighter idiom with the same meaning, so the combined change does no harm.
Preposition swap: 'iemand in die huis' (someone in the household) and 'iemand by die huis' (someone at home) are not quite the same, and the original is natural Afrikaans.

besluite.fout: 'wat die skool en ander grootmense moet stop' can be misread at first as 'adults must stop'; bare transitive 'stop' leans on English.
besluite.rede: 'stopsit' is the idiomatic verb for putting an end to something and removes the misreading without changing who must act.

besluite.fout: 'Sy het Nandi ... saam met haar ... geneem' is redundant and 'haar' momentarily invites a reading as Nandi.
besluite.rede: 'saam ... geneem' already says the teacher took Nandi along, with no unclear pronoun and the same meaning.
Placing 'met albei se tasse' after the verb is acceptable narrative Afrikaans and ends the paragraph on the image, so the reorder is lateral in a story.
